desc:
METRO DESTRUCTION WARS [BETA 0.9]

ROBLOXIA vs. REDCLIFF — All-out battlefield where EVERY building can be blown to pieces.
Ram tanks through walls. Shoot planes out of the sky. Fire POWERFUL weaponry. Leave NOTHING standing.

- Some of the most performant and satisfying destruction physics ON ROBLOX!
- 7 Fully Destructible Maps
- 65+ Weapons (yes there's that many) & 50 Progression Levels
- Tanks, Planes & Power Armor Suits
- Dynamic Thunderstorms, Blizzards & Dust Storms
- Smart NPC Squads Fighting Alongside Both Factions

Push the frontline, drop the enemy base shield, and blow their Core to pieces.

Inspired by classic Roblox war games
Game is in beta so nothing is set in stone
Full PC, Console & Mobile support
Join our community via the Social Links below!
